hero.name: Adam Airil

Recipient of the Vice Chancellor’s Award, a straight Dean's List achiever (Semesters 1-6), and Gold Award winner at the Workshop 2 Innovation Competition.
about.activities: Active technical contributor and leader within the UTeM ecosystem. Experienced public speaker, representing my cohort as the Dean's List student speaker and working as an emcee for formal faculty programs and the campus Neon Run.
